requirements_summary: Workload: low-latency chat & doc search; targets: p50 ~180-220ms, p95 <400-500ms at 30-50 QPS per cluster. Cost sensitivity: target 30-40% unit cost reduction vs current hosted baseline. Must support per-tenant residency and CMK/KMS. poc_details: Hosted POC run on 3 sample routes: support-chat, doc-search, re-rank. Dataset: 120k docs + 40k support transcripts (anonymized). Baseline token spend high due to long contexts; experiments: aggressive prefix caching reduced token usage ~22% in early tests; batching tests improved throughput but increased tail latency — need kernel/queue tuning in Dedicated runtime.
optimization_findings: Initial workshop identified three levers: 1) prefix/KV caching for repeated doc contexts (estimated -18% token cost), 2) adaptive batching with latency windows (-25% token cost at acceptable p95 tradeoff), 3) 4-bit quantized model variant for lower unit GPU cost (compatibility check pending). Combined estimated unit reduction: 35-45% depending on traffic mix.
